detail.statement: Computational creativity frameworks require robust integration between formulation and evaluation components for agents to autonomously navigate and identify novel, worthwhile problems.
detail.reason: Existing survey frameworks classify problem components effectively, but autonomous problem identification (formulation) is intrinsically linked to how agents evaluate potential problem spaces against internal value systems, such as cognitive effort in active inference models.
